Latest Settlements$3,000,000Wrongful death$1,800,00018 Wheeler $775,000Wrongful death View Our Office Locations & Phone Numbers Losing a family member or loved one is a difficult time in people’s lives. The team of attorneys at Warren & Griffin feel that no one should lose a family member or loved one due to someone else’s negligence, carelessness or recklessness. Wrongful death lawsuits can gain justice for your loved one’s death and well-deserved compensation for your loss. Wrongful death suits can be filed due to deaths that were a result of: Car Accidents Unsafe Workplaces And Many More Situations… Start Your Free Legal Consultation Right Now! Time Could Be Running Out! In most cases, a wrongful death lawsuit must be filed by a surviving spouse or immediate family member of the victim and should be filed within one year of the wrongful death. If you continue waiting, you could end up surrendering your right to receive justice and compensation on behalf of your deceased loved one. ZERO Attorney Fee Guarantee At Warren & Griffin, our primary concern is to provide victims of any type of injury with access to an experienced attorney who can protect their rights and get them the compensation that they deserve. We offer a FREE, no obligation legal consultation. In addition to offering a free legal consultation, Warren & Griffin do not charge our clients any legal or attorney’s fees unless we receive money from the insurance company on their behalf. Don’t settle with the insurance company until you talk to Warren & Griffin! We Deliver Results Reach Us 24/7 No Attorney’s Fee Unless You Win HOW MUCH MONEY IS MY CASE WORTH? Choose the Best of the Best Warren & Griffin has been voted Chattanooga’s best law firm for six years in a row. Schedule a consultation with us to find out why! BEST OF THE BEST LAW FIRM How did Mark and John Mark meet?Like, Subscribe and Comment on YouTube Start Your Free Legal Consultation Right Now! If you’re ready to consult with an attorney and start working with Warren & Griffin, you can begin your free legal consultation by completing the form on this page. After we review the specific circumstances of your family member’s wrongful death, one of our lawyers will contact you to schedule your appointment. Our law firm has three convenient office locations including our headquarters in Chattanooga, Tennessee; one in Dalton, Georgia and another in Mobile, Alabama.
